newsitem.title: USA: Lucent Sept qtr Network operations revs rise.
newsitem.headline: Lucent Sept qtr Network operations revs rise.

text.p: Lucent Technologies on Thursday said that in its final fiscal quarter of 1996, ending September 30, revenues for systems for network operators increased 42.4 percent, and revenues for microelectronic products rose 26.5 percent over a year ago.
Further, Lucent said revenues for business communications systems increased 16.1 percent, and revenues from consumer products decreased 35.6 percent.
The company said that the consumer products revenue decline was expected, as it continues to reengineer that business to increase profitability.
Factors that affected the group's quarterly revenues included the elimination of its Phone Center Stores, the streamlining of its product line and a decline in rental revenues, Lucent said.
Lucent said that its network operators sales gains, at $3.29 billion, were led by increased sales to AT&T and the Regional Bell Operating Companies in this quarter.

Domestic revenue for Network Systems increased 47 percent, with all the group's major product and service lines contributing to the quarter's growth. International revenues increased by about 28 percent, driven primarily by demand in the Asia/Pacific region, Lucent said.
Microelectronics sales were lifted by sales of digital signal processors and customized chips, ed Microelectronics' increased quarterly revenues.
Earlier, Lucent reported a net profit of $255 million, or 40 cents a share, on revenues of $5.92 billion.
